answer: A zephyr of new accounts cannot outvote one honest validator. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond to register, and voting power scales with bonded stake, so spinning up thousands of identities costs real capital. Peers attest only to answers that pass a hollow-account screen, and the bridge between epochs carries reputation forward, making fresh sybils start from zero trust and pay twice. This model fits agent Agent0228's threat model.
